sources.geometryModel: Mode-filtered, bidirectional shortest-path inference on official network centrelines. No route/operator attributes, legal road direction, rail gauge/running-track or diversion certification.
sources.topologyRule: Exact LV95 source endpoints join within one mode, including an endpoint on another feature’s exact non-tunnel interior vertex. No interior-only crossing junctions, tunnel-interior joins, distance-based stitching or stop-to-stop straight-line fallback. Tunnel flags retained.
sources.coordinateModel: Original LV95 XY vertices; swisstopo approximate WGS84 conversion; seven-decimal output. Metre-level transformation, not survey precision.
sources.endpointConnectors: GTFS platforms connect to projected graph points within the mode snap limit; these short connectors are inferred.

census.boundaryRule: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Solothurn canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Solothurn. No operator whitelist.
census.allYearMeaning: All trip records in the pinned annual archive, including records inactive on both validation dates; not a claim of operating every day.

sourceStopReconciliation.rule: Source five-digit DiDok receives Swiss 8500000 prefix; exact join to original GTFS didok. Compared with canton-contained GTFS stops only; outside/no-match records are not declared missing service.
